item.title: Collect a parcel from the shop
item.context_text: You are going to collect a parcel for your flat. Read the text and speak to the shop assistant.
item.objective_text: Pick up the correct parcel or find a simple way to collect it later.
success_conditions: Pick up the correct parcel or find a simple way to collect it later.

children.title: Read the parcel text
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Parcel ready at King Street Shop. Collection code: 642. Come before six. Bring ID. Go to the counter at the back.

questions.explanation: The message says to use the counter at the back.

children.title: Hear the shop’s new hours
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Hello. The shop will shut at five today. If you cannot come by five, your parcel will still be here tomorrow. We open at nine.

questions.prompt: When does the shop shut today?
questions.explanation: Today the shop is shutting at five.

questions.prompt: What is the earliest time to come tomorrow?

children.title: Ask at the counter
children.prompt_text: You made it to the shop before five. Tell the assistant what you need.
children.instructions: Give the collection code in clear, separate digits. Offer to show your ID.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Hello, I am here for a parcel. My code is six four two. I have my ID here if you need it.

children.title: Send a fallback plan
children.prompt_text: Imagine you miss today’s closing time after all. Your flatmate asks what to do tomorrow.
children.instructions: Tell them where to go, the earliest time, and what to take. Use a greeting so it reads like a real message.
children.goal: Pick up the correct parcel or find a simple way to collect it later.
children.model_answer: Hi Jo, please go to King Street Shop tomorrow. It opens at nine. Ask for the parcel at the back counter. The code is 642. Please bring your ID. I can meet you there if you like.
